name: traces_service_error_rate_high
title: Service error rate above 5%
description: A service had more than 5% of its server and consumer spans (requests and queue messages it handled) with status ERROR in the last 10 minutes, with at least 50 requests. Uses span status, not HTTP status codes. Needs OpenTelemetry traces in the traces stream named default.

query_condition.sql: SELECT service_name, COUNT(*) AS requests, SUM(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS error_pct FROM "default" WHERE span_kind IN ('2', '5') GROUP BY service_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 AND SUM(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 5
